method: Same-model (meta-llama/llama-3-8b-instruct), different-deployment comparison: Ollama local vs OpenRouter:DeepInfra cloud, with identical seed=42 and temperature=0.

cloud.robustness_note: Cloud LLaMA had 2 runs with substantially fewer valid items than expected (likely DeepInfra rate-limit / transient failure). This is itself a finding about cloud-deployment reliability.

headline_finding: Same model weights (meta-llama/llama-3-8b-instruct), seed=42, temperature=0; different deployment: local EMR=1.000 (n=435), cloud strict EMR=NA (n_items_in_all_10_runs=0); cloud mean pairwise disagreement 0.0079; cross-deployment canonical agreement: 61.2%. Asymmetric discordance: cloud labels 167 items as exclude that local labels include, vs only 0 reverse. This refutes the model-size confound: deployment infrastructure ALONE introduces material non-determinism.
